output.content: Hey team, I wanted to share my thoughts on the data labeling process. I think keeping it manual gives us the flexibility we need to handle edge cases and ensure high-quality data. The more control we have over the labeling, the better we can adapt to new scenarios. More manual control means we can fine-tune the process as needed, which is crucial for our data operations. {data_dave}
